title: AutoTuneMPC
description: Constrained nonlinear MPC and Optuna tuning over HTTPS JSON.

tools.name: identify_discrete_plant
tools.description:
Fit a discrete linear A, B, and dt from logged (t, u, y) samples.

This tool stays free when payment enforcement is on. It does not call
IPOPT. Pass the returned matrices to ``solve_mpc`` as a linear system.
Send 4 to 2000 samples. Each ``y`` has length 1..24 and each ``u`` has
length 1..12, the same widths on every row, all finite, with strictly
increasing timestamps. Anything else is rejected before the fit.

request.description: Logged (t, u, y) samples for a free discrete linear fit. No X-API-Key and no x402 charge. Pass A, B, and dt to solve_mpc after a free validate_problem.

samples.description: Logged (t, u, y) rows. Length 4 to 2000. This fit is free: no X-API-Key and no x402 charge.

items.description: One logged sample. ``u`` and ``y`` are scalars or vectors.

t.description: Sample time. Must be finite, and strictly increasing from row to row. Use one time unit for the whole log.

u.description: Input sample, length 1 to 12. A scalar is wrapped as a one-element list. Every row uses the same length.

y.description: Output sample, length 1 to 24. A scalar is wrapped as a one-element list. Every row uses the same length.

tools.name: validate_problem
tools.description:
Check dimensions, bounds, and linear controllability before a solve.

This is POST /v1/validate and stays free when payment enforcement is on.
It does not use X-API-Key and it does not return HTTP 402. Call it before
solve_mpc when you want the plant rejected without spending a credit.

system.description: Plant to check. This call is free: no X-API-Key and no x402 charge. Run it before the paid solve, and before autotune.

oneOf.description:

Continuous ``(A, B, Bd)`` are converted with a matrix exponential / zero-order

x_max.description: Upper state bounds, length nx, in the plant's state units. Omit for 1e6 on each state. State bounds are soft.

u_min.description: Lower input bounds, length nu, in the plant's input units. Omit for -1e6 on each input. Input bounds are hard.

u_max.description: Upper input bounds, length nu, in the plant's input units. Omit for 1e6 on each input. Input bounds are hard.

du_min.description: Lower slew bounds on delta-u, length nu. Omit for -1e6 on each input. Slew bounds are hard.

du_max.description: Upper slew bounds on delta-u, length nu. Omit for 1e6 on each input. Slew bounds are hard.

kind.description: Plant kind. Must be "nonlinear" for a registered template.

name.description: Registered template: double_integrator, thermal_rc_zone, soil_moisture_cascade, or unicycle_kinematics.

parameters.description: Template knobs, one number per required key. double_integrator and unicycle_kinematics: dt > 0 (seconds). thermal_rc_zone: dt > 0, capacity > 0, time_constant > 0, and ambient. soil_moisture_cascade: dt > 0, capacity > 0, tau_1 > 0, tau_2 > 0, tau_3 > 0, k_12 >= 0, k_23 >= 0. x_min.description: Lower state bounds, length nx, in the plant's state units. Omit for -1e6 on each state. State bounds are soft.

du_max.description: Upper slew bounds on delta-u, length nu. Omit for 1e6 on each input. Slew bounds are hard.

x_ref.description: State reference, length nx. Omit to skip that length check.

Q.description: Stage state weight, shape nx by nx. Omit to skip the weight check.

R.description: Input weight, shape nu by nu. Omit to skip the weight check.

Rd.description: Slew weight, shape nu by nu. Omit to skip the weight check.

Qf.description: Terminal state weight, shape nx by nx. Omit to skip the weight check.

d_hat.description: Disturbance estimate, length nd. Omit to skip that length check.

request.description: Free plant check. No X-API-Key and no x402 charge. Call this before the paid solve_mpc, and before autotune.

tools.name: solve_mpc
tools.description:
Solve a multi-step constrained MPC problem on the server.

Use this when the horizon has soft state bounds, hard input and slew limits,
and an offset-free disturbance rejection term. Pass the same ``session_id``
on later calls of one closed loop so the shifted primal and dual warm start
is restored. Omit ``session_id`` for a single stateless solve.

Do not call this for a one-step linear update you can do locally (a matrix
multiply, a threshold, or reading a sensor). Those do not need IPOPT.
CasADi and IPOPT return u0 and the predicted trajectory for robotics,
energy storage, and process control. session_id is the warm start.

This is POST /v1/solve at $0.02. Send header X-API-Key when a $29 pack still
has solve credits. With no key, or when those credits are gone, the call is
HTTP 402 and an agent pays with x402. There is no second payment path.

Set ``reset_warm_start`` or call the ``reset_warm_start`` tool to drop the
seed for that session. The compiled solver stays. A reset only clears the
seed stored for the caller who owns it.

system.description: Plant to control. Free validate_problem first, then this paid solve, then autotune if the weights are still unknown.

tools.name: reset_warm_start
tools.description:
Clear one session's shifted primal and dual.

Next ``solve_mpc`` / ``POST /v1/solve`` with this ``session_id`` is cold.
The compiled solver stays. Stateless calls omit ``session_id`` and already
clear warm-start memory, so they do not use this tool.

session_id.description: Session id whose warm-start seed to drop. Required, and at most 128 characters. Free: it does not spend a credit. The compiled solver stays. The next solve_mpc with this id is a cold start. Clearing an unknown id changes nothing.

tools.name: start_autotune_job
tools.description:
Queue an Optuna search for Q, R, Rd, and Qf. Then poll ``get_autotune_job``.

The tuner needs a model, either matrices ``A`` and ``B`` or one registered
template. There is no entry for a custom nonlinear equation besides those
templates. Obstacle and path-frame navigation stayed in Apex_nav.

Call this when the weights are unknown and you can afford a closed-loop
study with plant mismatch. Optuna tunes Q, R, Rd, and Qf and reports
overshoot and settling time. It is an alternative to manual PID or
hand-tuned MPC. The reply is a ``job_id``. When payment
enforcement is on it also includes a ``job_token`` for ``get_autotune_job``.
It does not contain the weights. Poll until ``status`` is ``complete`` or
``failed``. The finished result's ``Q``, ``R``, ``Rd``, and ``Qf`` are the
physical weights. ``normalized_Q`` and its siblings are the unitless search box.

Payment settles when the job is accepted onto the queue, not when the study
finishes. This is POST /v1/autotune at $1.50. Send header X-API-Key when a
$29 pack still has an autotune credit. With no key, or when those credits
are gone, the call is HTTP 402 and an agent pays with x402. A full queue is HTTP 429 and is not charged. The study itself stops
at ``timeout_seconds``. A process restart marks leftover ``running`` rows
``failed`` with ``interrupted_by_restart`` instead of deleting a paid job.

tools.name: get_autotune_job
tools.description:
Read one autotune job started by ``start_autotune_job``.

``status`` is ``running``, ``complete``, or ``failed``. On ``complete``,
``result`` holds the Pareto-best weights, overshoot, settling time, RMSE,
and solve time. Poll again while it is ``running``. When payment enforcement
is on, pass the ``job_token`` from the start call or the ``X-Job-Token``
header. A failed job reports ``autotune_failed``.

job_token.description: Token returned with the job when payment enforcement is on. Omit it when the X-Job-Token header carries the same token. This poll is free and does not spend a credit.

tools.name: autotune_root_zone_irrigation
tools.description:
Tune valve weights for the three-layer root-zone irrigation template.

Same payment as autotune_template: X-API-Key spends 2 autotune credits, and
a missing key or an empty pack is HTTP 402 for x402.

max_trials.description: Optuna trials for the root-zone irrigation plant. Default 20. Values below 1 are raised to 1. Paid at $2.00: X-API-Key spends 2 autotune credits, or HTTP 402 is x402 Base USDC. Each call starts a new study.

tools.name: autotune_embedded_controller_with_c_codegen
tools.description:
Tune a linear plant and write a zero-heap C99 bundle.

The reply's ``codegen`` object lists ``mpc_bundle.h`` and ``mpc_bundle.c``
plus ``usage_example_c`` and ``controller_kind``. A linear plant is a
condensed QP (``linear_qp``). A nonlinear plant, including differential
drive, is a linearized real-time iteration (``linearized_rti``): Jacobians
at the current state, then projected-gradient steps. That is not a full
nonlinear SQP. Compile with
``gcc -O3 -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -fPIC -shared -lm``. Each control step is
``mpc_compute_u0`` then, after the plant measurement, ``mpc_observer_update``.
Neither function allocates on the heap. ``MPC_NX``, ``MPC_NU``, ``MPC_ND``,
and ``MPC_HORIZON`` in the header are the array sizes.

Same payment as autotune_template: X-API-Key spends 2 autotune credits, and
a missing key or an empty pack is HTTP 402 for x402.

max_trials.description: Optuna trials before the C99 bundle is written. Default 1. Values below 1 are raised to 1. Paid at $2.00: X-API-Key spends 2 autotune credits, or HTTP 402 is x402 Base USDC. Each call starts a new study and writes a new bundle.

tools.name: autotune_template
tools.description:
Tune differential_drive, battery_peak_shaving, or root_zone_irrigation.

This is POST /v1/templates/autotune at $2.00. The name is differential_drive,
battery_peak_shaving, or root_zone_irrigation. The reply returns tuned
Q, R, Rd, and Qf. Send name and max_trials.
Send header X-API-Key when a $29 pack still has autotune credits. One call
spends 2 of those credits. With no key, or when the credits are gone, the
call is HTTP 402 and an agent pays with x402. The reply returns the tuned
weights for that template. Payment uses the same gate as the HTTP route.

name.description: Built-in plant: root_zone_irrigation, battery_peak_shaving, or differential_drive.

max_trials.description: Optuna trials for that plant. Default 20, must be >= 1 and <= 30.

request.description: Paid template tune at $2.00 for differential_drive, battery_peak_shaving, or root_zone_irrigation. Send X-API-Key (spends 2 autotune credits) or pay HTTP 402 with x402 on Base USDC. Validate a custom plant free first; these three names are built in. Each call starts a new study.
